title: Predicting abnormal birth weight and identifying associated factors using machine learning in the Hararghe Health and Demographic Surveillance System, Ethiopia.
summary: XGBoost predicted abnormal birth weight among 11,553 singleton births in an Ethiopian surveillance dataset; AUC 0.835 and accuracy 0.72. Retrospective cross-sectional design does not establish causal risk factors.
ai_technology: XGBoost predicts abnormal birth weight from Ethiopian surveillance records and ranks contributing predictors.
organization: College of Health and Medical Sciences, Haramaya University, Harar, Ethiopia

evidence.tested: XGBoost predicted abnormal birth weight among 11,553 singleton births in an Ethiopian surveillance dataset; AUC 0.835 and accuracy 0.72. Retrospective cross-sectional design does not establish causal risk factors.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
